headline: Green Cross Health Half-Year Profit Surges on Medical Division Sale
summary: Green Cross Health reported a surge in half-year profit driven by the one-off gain from the sale of its medical division on July 31, while underlying earnings remained little changed.
why: Divestments of major business units distort headline earnings while revealing corporate restructuring and asset monetization strategies for healthcare providers.

impacts.name: Green Cross Health
impacts.why: Asset sales generate substantial one-off accounting profits that boost headline net income.
